about: TALLOW corrupted narration. Mim's second voice over the existing recordings. Lines are deterministic: a cue plays every time its recording plays, so a player can replay a page to check what they heard.
timing_note: start_seconds are from the start of the original asset; a chained line (chain_after set) starts chain_gap seconds after the previous line ends, on its own clock, and its start_seconds repeats the cue anchor. interrupt_seconds and est_duration are word-rate estimates: replace them with the rendered take length plus 0.25 s at import. timing=measured means the anchor edge sits on a detected pause in the exported VO; estimated means a word-rate guess. Snap estimated cues with forced alignment before shipping. Rendered: est_duration and duration_seconds are the real file lengths; interrupt_seconds on a break cue that starts a chain covers the whole chain plus 0.25 s. Levels are baked into the files (play at engine_gain_db 0). Lengths from the second, harsher render (Tools/FinalPass/voice2).

placements.under: plays at the same time as the original
placements.break: takes over briefly; readings hold via Interrupt, slides duck
placements.after: after the original ends; slide/page hold must extend to the cue end plus 0.8 s; after-cues still play if the page was closed

min_playthrough_note: 2 = only after the player has seen any ending once. Needs a persistent completed-story flag in the save.

chapters.coda: confession, after either ending if the letter was read

presets.CR_UNDER: Under the original, never ducking it. Band-limit 250 Hz to 3.5 kHz, slow wow, dark wide reverb, low shadow voice at -6 dB under the sweet one. Meant to be half heard.
presets.CR_SEAM: Inside an existing pause. Tape flutter, light grit, 15 ms fades. May run up to 0.4 s into the next word, then the original carries on.
presets.CR_BREAK: Briefly dominant. Readings: hold the original with FTallowReadingPlayback::Interrupt for interrupt_seconds. Slides: duck the narration -15 dB instead. 60 ms tape-stop into the line, one stutter on the first syllable, dropout on release.
presets.CR_AFTER: After the original ends, in the room rather than on the tape. Nearly dry, close, no glitch, faint low shadow only. Reserved for the worst information: the plainer the line, the less processing.
presets.CR_FLUE: Thomas speaking. Narrow tube resonance (comb around 180 to 400 Hz), boxy, low-passed at 4 kHz, small and far, as if from inside a chimney.
presets.CR_MANY: Plural lines. Three takes of the same line stacked 8 to 15 ms apart, plus or minus 20 cents, no reverb.
